story.title: Princess Zaphira & The Art of Algerian Haute Couture
story.intro: Inspired by the legendary 16th-century Queen of Algiers, Princess Zaphira was renowned across the Mediterranean for her unyielding dignity, magnetic grace, and exquisite sartorial taste.
story.atelierText: In our studio in the historic heart of Algiers, every Zaphira piece begins with hand-selected materials: woven cords, velvety chenille, cloud-soft bouclé and gilded clasps, crocheted stitch by stitch.
story.personalText: We believe true luxury is personal. By inviting each patron to choose their palette, pearl size, hardware, and personalized hot-stamped monogram initials, every creation becomes an heirloom reflecting its owner’s unique identity.

about.metaDescription: Maison Zaphira: handmade bags from our Algiers atelier, inspired by the legend of Princess Zaphira.
about.heroTitle: Born in Algiers, made by hand, made for you.
about.heroText: Zaphira is an Algerian house of handmade bags. Each piece is woven, knitted and finished by hand in our Algiers atelier, then made to order for the woman who will carry it.
about.manifesto: “We believe a bag should carry a story: the patience of the hands that made it, and the personality of the woman who chose it.”
about.legendText1: Algerian tradition tells of Zaphira, wife of the prince of Algiers in the early 16th century. The stories passed down through the centuries remember a woman of great dignity, elegance and loyalty, who refused to give up who she was.
about.legendText2: We chose her name for what it stands for: a quiet strength, a sense of beauty rooted in Algeria, and the freedom to remain oneself. It is the spirit we want every Zaphira bag to carry.
about.atelierText1: Our bags are not produced in series. In the Algiers atelier, each one is built row by row: cords woven on a structured frame, chenille and bouclé knitted by hand, pearls set one by one, hardware fitted and checked.
about.atelierText2: Because every piece is made to order, our client service calls you after each order to confirm the details and the delivery date. It is the time it takes to make something properly.
about.stepsTitle: From the first thread to your door
about.step1Text: Cords, chenille, bouclé, velvet and pearls are selected for their touch, their colour and how they age.
about.step2Text: The body of the bag is woven or knitted by hand, stitch by stitch, following the pattern of each model.
about.step3Text: Pearls are set by hand, then clasps, chains and handles are fitted and adjusted.
about.step4Text: For bespoke creations, your colours, materials and gold monogram are applied in the atelier.
about.step5Text: Each bag is inspected, then placed in its Picasso-blue Zaphira box with a beige band and gold monogram, inside the matching ribbon-handled bag.
about.commit1Text: Every bag is made by hand in our Algiers atelier.
about.commit2Text: No overproduction: your bag is made for you once you order it.
about.commit3Text: Complimentary delivery to all 69 wilayas, with cash on delivery.
about.commit4Title: A real person to talk to
about.commit4Text: Our client service confirms every order by phone and answers on WhatsApp.
about.ctaTitle: Create a bag that is truly yours
about.ctaText: Choose the colour, material, pearls, chain and monogram in our bespoke studio, or talk to an advisor.

universe.metaDescription: The Zaphira universe: Picasso’s single line, the blue of the Mediterranean and the art of handmade.
universe.heroText: Our bags are born on the shores of Algiers, between the blue of the sea and the white of the Casbah. Our pen is Picasso’s single line: free, feminine, sure of itself.
universe.manifesto: “A woman who carries a Zaphira carries a work of art: drawn by hand, made by hand, chosen with the heart.”
universe.ch1Text: A face drawn in one stroke, without lifting the pen. This is the gesture we chose as our signature: you find it in gold on our boxes, our cards and our bags, a reminder that true elegance is a single, confident line.
universe.ch2Text: The waves of Tipaza, the white terraces of Algiers, the gold of the southern dunes: our colours come from the landscapes we love. Our chevron stitch draws the sea; our sand tones carry the warmth of the Sahara.
universe.ch3Text: Up to thirty hours of work, thousands of counted stitches, a clasp chosen for each model, a lining sewn by hand. We believe the beauty of a bag is in what you see and in what you feel when you carry it.
universe.palette2Text: The sea at noon, from the bay of Algiers
universe.palette3Text: The beige of our ribbons and bands
universe.palette4Text: The line of the portrait, the clasp, the Z
universe.palette5Text: The softness of a woman’s smile
universe.motifsText: The face, the wave, the eye, the olive branch, the arch of the Casbah and the sun: six drawings that say who we are.
universe.ctaTitle: Find the bag that tells your story
